title: [FancyZones] Priority grid zone positions are not consistent
author: JordanAnthonyKing
summary: When a Priority Grid layout changes zone count, windows remain attached by zone number rather than by spatially corresponding zone, causing unintuitive moves.
next_action: Reproduce current Priority Grid transitions and define a spatial zone-matching acceptance rule before changing persistence.

confidence.rationale: The defect and numeric mapping behavior are directly confirmed; only the modern acceptance rule remains.

judgment.rationale: The report includes exact layout transitions, screenshots, a code-level explanation, and later maintainer confirmation that windows stay with the same zone number.
evidence: Adding a zone to the left causes windows in the large priority zone to move to a different visual zone.
The issue explains that zone numbering is left-to-right rather than based on spatial correspondence across templates.
A maintainer confirmed in 2022 that windows stay in the zone with the same number.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce current Priority Grid transitions and define a spatial zone-matching acceptance rule before changing persistence.

fix_assessment.rationale: The behavior is established, but current layout internals and the desired matching rule require maintainer validation before a safe fix design.

issue_context.summary: When a Priority Grid layout changes zone count, windows remain attached by zone number rather than by spatially corresponding zone, causing unintuitive moves.
known_information: The behavior depends on the setting that moves assigned windows during layout changes.
Priority Grid zone geometry changes when the zone count changes.
inferences: Matching by overlap or centroid may preserve visual intent better than numeric identity, but tie-breaking and custom layouts need definition.
issue_context.analysis: A current reproduction plus explicit matching criteria is the smallest next step; the old proposed SetId change may not fit today's layout model.
initial_investigation: Read the historical proposed code change and later maintainer confirmation.
Confirmed current FancyZones has separate Layout and AppZoneHistory components, so the old ZoneSet sketch cannot be assumed current.

actions.label: Reproduce Priority Grid zone remapping
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Change Priority Grid zone count with assigned windows
prerequisites: During layout changes, windows assigned to a zone will match new size/position enabled
setup: Apply the two-zone Priority Grid layout.
Place one window in the large priority zone and one in the other zone.
steps: Increase Priority Grid to three zones.
Record which new zone receives each window.
Decrease the zone count and repeat.
Compare numeric-zone retention with maximum-overlap or nearest-center matching.
reproduce.expected_result: Windows should remain in the visually corresponding zone according to a documented deterministic rule.
